courses.overview: 由晶軸、電光重疊與異質界面延伸到不同工法，保留物理關係並重新界定系統邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Extend crystal orientation, electro-optic overlap and heterogeneous interfaces to related methods while retaining physical relationships and redefining system boundaries.

related.title: 馬赫曾德爾調變器
related.why: 兩課都由差動相位產生干涉調變。
related.whyEn: Both convert differential phase into intensity modulation.
related.transfer: 兩課都由差動相位產生干涉調變。
related.transferEn: Both convert differential phase into intensity modulation.
related.difference: 鈮酸鋰採電光張量；矽 MZI 常用載子改變折射率，損耗與偏壓機制不同。
related.differenceEn: Lithium niobate uses an electro-optic tensor; silicon MZIs often use carriers, with different loss and bias mechanisms.
practice: 用同一長度比較相移效率與吸收預算。
在兩課中各選一個能推翻結論的量測。
標出交接時不能直接沿用的材料參數或控制條件。
practiceEn: Compare phase efficiency and absorption budgets at equal length.
Choose one falsifying measurement in each course.
Identify material parameters or control conditions that cannot be transferred unchanged.

related.title: 微轉印雷射晶粒整合
related.why: 微轉印可把異質材料局部放到目標波導。
related.whyEn: Micro-transfer printing places heterogeneous materials locally on target waveguides.
related.transfer: 微轉印可把異質材料局部放到目標波導。
related.transferEn: Micro-transfer printing places heterogeneous materials locally on target waveguides.
related.difference: 雷射晶粒還需要增益、電流與散熱；被動鈮酸鋰薄膜沒有雷射閾值。
related.differenceEn: Laser coupons additionally need gain, current and cooling; passive lithium-niobate films have no laser threshold.
practice: 畫出薄膜與雷射晶粒的兩種電極與熱路。
在兩課中各選一個能推翻結論的量測。

practiceEn: Draw separate electrode and thermal paths for a film and laser coupon.
Choose one falsifying measurement in each course.

courses.summary: 薄膜鈮酸鋰異質整合以晶軸、電光重疊與異質界面連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: Heterogeneous thin-film lithium-niobate integration links device physics and system validation through crystal orientation, electro-optic overlap and heterogeneous interfaces. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以晶軸、電光重疊與異質界面比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through crystal orientation, electro-optic overlap and heterogeneous interfaces, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: 晶圓尺度轉印展示
history.text: Ghent University / Optics Letters 的「200 mm 矽光子晶圓的鈮酸鋰微轉印實驗」提供可追溯的發展案例。它支援本課的原理與設計問題；課程算例另行設定，並不冒充該研究的性能。研究事件與地圖的封裝代表據點分開標示，不主張兩者發生在同一地點。
history.textEn: Ghent University / Optics Letters: Lithium-niobate transfer printing on a 200-mm silicon photonics wafer provides a traceable development example. It informs the principles and design questions; course calculations use separate assumptions and do not claim that study's performance. The research event and the representative packaging location are distinct and are not claimed to share a site.

history.title: 從單元件指標到可測試系統
history.titleEn: From component metrics to testable systems
history.text: 本課把晶軸、電光重疊與異質界面放在材料、介面及封裝的連續證據鏈中。下列原始研究與機構資料呈現不同發展路線；此欄是教學脈絡，並非宣稱此地的發明年表。
history.textEn: This course puts crystal orientation, electro-optic overlap and heterogeneous interfaces within a continuous evidence chain of materials, interfaces and packaging. The primary studies and institutional records show different development routes; this is learning context, not a claimed invention timeline for this location.
